item.title: Agents can now create Cloudflare accounts, buy domains, and deploy
item.description:
📝 Starting today, agents can provision Cloudflare on behalf of their users. This all works via a new protocol that we’ve co-designed with Stripe as part of the launch of Stripe Projects. Providers like Cloudflare make this catalog available via a simple REST API that returns JSON, and that gives agents everything they need.
🔗 Read more: https://blog.cloudflare.com/agents-stripe-projects/
